title: UnifiedFlowchartSchema
description: Schema definition for a single-file interactive flowchart configuration in the Interactive Loom Learning OS.

entities.description: A map of unique node entity IDs to their definition.

title.description: Default visual label for the node.

viewTitles.description: Optional mapping to override the title inside specific views (e.g. verb-based for EVENT_STORMING, noun-based for SYS_ARCH).

desc.description: Helpful tooltip or summary text for the entity.

viewTypes.description: A map from View Name to the node stereotype (determines color, border, and icon). Valid types are: Actor, Event, Command, Policy, Aggregate, Service, Database, Process, Data Object, Decision, External API, Risk, Read Model.

relations.description: An array of edges linking node entities.

views.description: The list of views where this relation should be visible (e.g., ['EVENT_STORMING']).

dashed.description: Optional. Renders the edge as a dashed line (used for optional paths or loops).

handledBy.description: Optional. For EVENT_STORMING view, renders as a straight vertical green line indicating a command is handled by an aggregate/actor.

views.description: A map of view keys (e.g. EVENT_STORMING, SYS_ARCH, DATA_FLOW, SWIMLANES) to their layout projection configurations.

journeys.description: An array of selectable animations showing steps through the flowchart.

id.description: Unique slug for the journey (e.g., happy-path, recovery-path).

label.description: User-facing display name of the journey.

description.description: General description of what this journey demonstrates.

nodeIds.description: The node entity IDs highlighted concurrently in this step.

description.description: Text description shown near the highlighted node(s).

name.description: Display name of the view projection.

icon.description: Lucide icon name to display beside the view name.

nodes.description: The positioning of each node inside this view.

grid.description: Logical grid coordinates [column, row] (e.g. [0, 2]). Preferred over absolute x/y coordinates.

groups.description: Boundary boxes or swimlane bands clustering nodes.

title.description: Visual label of the boundary group.

desc.description: A short summary of what is contained inside this boundary.

nodeIds.description: The node entity IDs enclosed by this boundary box. Optional if isLane is true.

isLane.description: Optional. Set to true to draw a horizontal swimlane instead of a bounding box.

row.description: Optional (for swimlanes). The logical row index mapping this lane to the row timeline (0, 1, 2, 3, etc.).

y.description: Optional (for swimlanes/legacy). Y offset of the lane.

h.description: Optional (for swimlanes/legacy). Height of the lane.
